content.json:
# Security Posture

Microsoft Sentinel incidents, alert severity distribution, MITRE ATT&CK coverage, and UEBA anomaly trends.

content.query:
// Incident summary tiles
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| summarize
    Total = count(),
    Open = countif(Status == 'New' or Status == 'Active'),
    Closed = countif(Status == 'Closed'),
    High = countif(Severity == 'High'),
    Critical = countif(Severity == 'Critical' or Severity == 'Informational')
content.title: Sentinel Incident Summary
Incidents by Severity (Daily)
MITRE ATT&CK Tactic Distribution
Top Triggered Analytics Rules

content.query:
// UEBA anomaly timeline
BehaviorAnalytics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ActivityInsights has 'Anomaly'
| summarize Anomalies = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), UserPrincipalName
| order by Anomalies desc
| take 50
content.title: UEBA Anomaly Timeline

content.query:
// Mean Time to Triage (alert → incident)
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| extend AlertTime = todatetime(AdditionalData.alertProductNames)
| where isnotempty(CreatedTime) and isnotempty(FirstActivityTime)
| extend TriageMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', CreatedTime, FirstActivityTime)
| summarize AvgTriage = avg(TriageMinutes), MedianTriage = percentile(TriageMinutes, 50)
content.title: Mean Time to Triage

content.query:
// Failed sign-in heatmap
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResultType != '0'
| summarize FailedAttempts = count() by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Location
| order by FailedAttempts desc
| take 25
content.title: Failed Sign-In Sources (Top 25)
